description: This file defines the ComplexOperations class with static methods for performing complex number calculations such as division, subtraction, addition, and multiplication, utilizing the Complex class and related error handling.

classes.name: ComplexOperations
classes.description: A class providing static methods for complex number calculations such as division, subtraction, addition, and multiplication.

methods.name: IMDIV
methods.description: Performs division of two complex numbers, returning the result in text format or an array if inputs are arrays.

methods.name: IMSUB
methods.description: Performs subtraction of two complex numbers, returning the result in text format or an array if inputs are arrays.

methods.name: IMSUM
methods.description: Sums multiple complex numbers, returning the result in text format.

methods.name: IMPRODUCT
methods.description: Multiplies multiple complex numbers, returning the result in text format.
